name: Drawing Templates
author: TBIT DESIGN - Thomas Breher
description: TWELVE printable drawing templates from one image, computed entirely in your browser. PAINT BY NUMBERS (flattened color regions, thin contours, numbered legend - paint colors can be pinned to ten preset palettes, your brand kit or up to four custom colors), a COLORING PAGE with closed, smooth region outlines (real colorable patches), a dashed light-gray TRACING SHEET for pen practice, CONNECT THE DOTS where EVERY part of the motif becomes its own numbered contour (running numbers, red start rings, optional faint hint lines), a SYMMETRY DRAWING sheet (one half shows the motif, the other is an empty grid across a dashed mirror line), the classic GRID DRAWING AID (labeled grid over the picture next to an empty grid with the same labels), a STEP-BY-STEP GUIDE (the picture drawn in four or six numbered steps: placement silhouette, coarse, medium and fine outlines, hatched shading, finished tones), COLOR BY CODE (every region carries a little sum, difference, product or letter whose result names the color - addition, subtraction, mixed, times tables or letters, number range 10, 20 or 100, shuffle for a fresh set), SHADE BY NUMBERS (the pencil sibling: tones split into three to five bands, every region numbered, the legend shows each grey), a ONE-LINE DRAWING (one continuous line in rows or as a spiral whose swing follows the tone, start ring and end dot to trace), FINISH THE DRAWING (the outlines fade out across the sheet, or whole parts are missing with faint dotted hints) and COMPLETE THE MANDALA (the picture fills one wedge of a circle, the other wedges show only rings and spokes, optional ghost hints). Source: the whole document (default), any layer picked by name, or the media library. Every sheet takes a multi-line title in the editor font catalog with a text size factor. Insert as an editable layer and reopen via Edit Drawing Templates.
